Starting the dev server and taking screenshots:All views look right. Running the full check again after the layout changes:Done. Everything is implemented and verified.

## Files changed

**Added**
- `src/gallery/SpeakingStyleSelect.tsx` — shared native `<select>` labelled **Speaking style**; options `1 · Literal` … `5 · Curatorial`; `aria-describedby` hint "Numbered 1 to 5. Press a number key to choose that style directly."; digit keys 1–5 jump to the indexed style (all other keys fall through to native arrows/Home/End/type-ahead); Motion-animated accent + description keyed on mode.
- `tests/e2e/motion.spec.ts` — 5 new Playwright tests.

**Modified**
- `src/App.tsx` — `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"`; `AnimatePresence` carousel around `ArtworkStage` with a computed prev/next direction (shared by arrows and WebMCP); crossfading `.mode-atmosphere` layer; `SpeakingStyleSelect variant="label"` in the wall-label area; `#artwork-stage`/`tabIndex` moved to the stage wrapper.
- `src/gallery/ArtworkStage.tsx` — `motion.figure`; painting + frame + wall label move as one slide; per-artwork `artwork-title-*` id (no duplicate ids mid-transition); lens text removed from the fine print.
- `src/gallery/SettingsDialog.tsx` — five mode buttons replaced by the shared select; `AnimatePresence` + `onExitComplete` keeps the native dialog `open` through the exit, then `close()`s and returns focus; added `onCancel` handling and a 700 ms safety close.
- `src/gallery/modes.ts` — `modeAtmospheres` tokens for the crossfade.
- `src/app.css` — full-viewport borderless settings, transparent `::backdrop`, `style-select` layer, single stage cell (`grid-area: 1/1`) so an outgoing work cannot shift layout, `--style-reserve`, removed `mode-option`/`hang-the-work` CSS.
- `tests/setup.ts`, `tests/App.test.tsx`, `tests/accessibility.test.tsx`, `tests/tool-contracts.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/manual-gallery.spec.ts`, `tests/e2e/tool-gallery.spec.ts`.
- `package.json` / `package-lock.json`.

## Package added
`motion@13.1.1` (exact, current official release), used via `motion/react`: `motion.*`, `AnimatePresence`, `MotionConfig`, `useReducedMotion`.

## Results
- `npm run check`: typecheck clean · **48/48 vitest** (5 files) · build OK · **14/14 Playwright**. E2E re-run 3× — stable.
- `npm audit --audit-level=high`: **0 vulnerabilities**.
- Motion animations are asserted for real, not by screenshot: a patched `Element.prototype.animate` recorder counts animations on `.artwork-figure`/`.settings-panel`, and a MutationObserver times the gap between Escape and the dialog's `open` removal (>120 ms, proving the dialog outlives the exit).
- Reduced motion is asserted in Chromium via `emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'reduce'})` — jsdom can't cover it because Motion caches its media-query subscription per module instance; that's noted in `tests/setup.ts`.

## Screenshots (`/tmp/aiccessibility-shots/`)
`desktop.png`, `desktop-poetic.png`, `settings-desktop.png`, `carousel-end-state.png`, `mobile.png`, `settings-mobile.png`, `reduced-motion.png`. Two visual defects found and fixed during this pass: the settings select column was centred instead of aligned to the prose (grid `justify-content` inherited from the wall-label variant), and on mobile the select was stranded at the bottom of the viewport (hall re-centred as one group with a `--style-reserve`).

## Untouched, as required
The four WebMCP tools and their semantics; `docs/hackathon-build/*`; `docs/voice-validation.md`; `.devpost-hackathon-state.json`. No commit, push, or deploy. No TTS, accounts, persistence, tracking, or backend.

## Remaining risks
1. **Bundle size**: JS went to 353 kB raw / 112 kB gzipped (Motion is most of the increase). Fine for a static gallery, but it is the largest single cost of this change.
2. **Artwork dominance margin narrowed**: the select consumes vertical space, so at 1280×720 the image is ~403 px tall against the smoke test's 396 px floor (~2% headroom). A future font or label change could trip that assertion; `--style-reserve` / `--caption-reserve` are the knobs.
3. **Two figures share the stage mid-transition** (~460 ms). Locators that match `.artwork-image` or `.artwork-figure` without scoping will hit strict-mode violations; the specs now poll for a single figure first.
4. **Exit-completion fallback**: if Motion ever failed to report `onExitComplete`, the dialog closes on a 700 ms timer instead — correct, but the focus return would be that late.
5. **ChatGPT/Voice live validation is still unvalidated** — unchanged and not claimed anywhere.
